kaggle.blurb: Free Kaggle Learn micro-courses in a suggested order. Tick lessons as you finish them on Kaggle; progress is saved here.
kaggle.title: Kaggle Learn
kaggle.weightHint: Progress is weighted by Kaggle's published course hours, not by lesson count.

nndl.author: Michael Nielsen, 2015
nndl.blurb: The whole book, chapter by chapter: every section is a tick box, every exercise and problem is listed under the section it follows, and the bookmark takes you back to the exact anchor on the page.
nndl.title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
nndl.weightHint: Progress is weighted by the number of words in each section, counted from the book itself.

statapp.author: Paul-Henry Cournède, CentraleSupélec, 2019
statapp.blurb: Le polycopié officiel du cours de 1re année : chapitre par chapitre, chaque section avec sa page dans le PDF. Le sujet de TD suit en dernière étape, question par question. Le marque-page retient la section et le numéro de page où tu t'es arrêté.
statapp.title: Statistique & Apprentissage
statapp.weightHint: Progression pondérée par le nombre de pages de chaque section, relevé dans la table des matières et vérifié dans le PDF. Pour le sujet de TD, une question pèse la place que son énoncé occupe dans le PDF, en équivalents-pages : c'est une longueur d'énoncé, pas un temps de résolution.

cs229.author: Andrew Ng (Stanford Online)
cs229.blurb: Andrew Ng's Stanford course, lecture by lecture: linear and generative models, SVMs and kernels, learning theory, neural networks, unsupervised learning and reinforcement learning. Every lecture is a tick box and opens its own video.
cs229.title: Stanford CS229: Machine Learning (Autumn 2018)
cs229.weightHint: Progress is weighted by the length of each video, read from its YouTube page.

shap.author: Conor O'Sullivan (A Data Odyssey)
shap.blurb: The A Data Odyssey playlist on SHAP: the intuition and first code, the Shapley maths and its limits, then applications to classification, CatBoost and anomaly detection. Every video is a tick box and opens itself.
shap.title: SHAP: explaining models with Shapley values
shap.weightHint: Progress is weighted by the length of each video, read from its YouTube page.
